title: Check If A Parentheses String Can Be Valid
description:
You are given a non-empty parentheses string `s` and a binary string `locked` of the same length. At an index where `locked[i]` is `1`, `s[i]` cannot change. At an index where it is `0`, `s[i]` may be changed to either parenthesis. Return whether some allowed changes make `s` a valid parentheses string.

A valid parentheses string is empty, `()`, a concatenation of valid strings, or a valid string surrounded by a pair of parentheses.

## Examples

```text
Input: s = "))()))", locked = "010100"
Output: true
```

```text
Input: s = "()()", locked = "0000"
Output: true
```

```text
Input: s = ")", locked = "0"
Output: false
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= s.length == locked.length <= 10^5`
- `s` contains only `(` and `)`.
- `locked` contains only `0` and `1`.
